name: Support
description: Tickets/cases, SLAs, queues, assignment, multichannel communication (email, chat, voice), a knowledge base, macros/canned responses, CSAT, escalation, and a customer self-service portal for a customer support team.

sources.title: Chatwoot
sources.license: MIT (core); the enterprise/ directory ships a separate, non-MIT license file and is not covered by the MIT grant
sources.notes: License verified directly from root LICENSE ('Content outside of the above mentioned directories ... available under MIT Expat') plus a separate enterprise/LICENSE file; copy-safe for core code only, never the enterprise/ tree. app/models/message.rb confirms a boolean `private` field (internal notes). app/models/label.rb confirms tags/labels. conversations.status enum: open/resolved/pending/snoozed; sla_policy_id FK + AppliedSla model confirm core (non-enterprise-gated) SLA support. Macro model with actions including change_status/assign_team/send_webhook_event. Article model + portal/category/folder confirm a knowledge base. CsatSurveyResponse model (rating+feedback) confirms CSAT. api/v2/accounts/{reports,live_reports,summary_reports}_controller.rb (core, not enterprise/) confirm reporting/analytics.

sources.title: Zammad
sources.notes: License verified directly from root LICENSE (full AGPL-3.0 text); reference-only, never copy code. Ticket::State model (seeded): new, open, pending reminder, pending close, closed, merged. Explicit Sla model (response_time/update_time, condition-matched) plus an escalation calculation engine. calendar.rb confirms business-hours/holiday calendars. trigger.rb (condition/perform store) confirms rule-based automation. tag.rb confirms tagging. Customer role belongs_to on Ticket confirms a customer-facing portal role.

sources.title: osTicket
sources.notes: License verified directly from root LICENSE.txt (GPL-2.0 text) and GitHub's license API; resolves a conflicting earlier assumption of Apache-2.0 in favor of the actual GPL-2.0. Reference-only, never copy code. Ticket states via hasState() checks: open, resolved, closed, archived, deleted. SLA model with grace_period and FLAG_ESCALATE/FLAG_NOALERTS bitflags. class.knowledgebase.php/class.faq.php confirm a knowledge base. class.canned.php confirms canned responses. A dedicated client/ directory confirms a customer portal. class.thread.php has an explicit 'N' => 'note' entry type plus a FLAG_SYSTEM system-note flag, confirming internal notes.

sources.title: FreeScout
sources.license: AGPL-3.0 (core); the Modules/ directory hosts separately-sold commercial add-ons (including SLA and Reports) not covered by the AGPL grant
sources.notes: License verified directly from root LICENSE (full AGPL-3.0 text); reference-only, never copy code. Conversation status enum: active(1)/pending(2)/closed(3)/spam(4) (STATUS_OPEN=5 is dead code, superseded by active). TYPE_EMAIL/PHONE/CHAT/CUSTOM channel enum confirms multi-channel support including phone. No SLA model found in core — confirms SLA is a paid Modules/ add-on here, not core AGPL code; this caps freescout's contribution to the SLA/escalation feature at zero (excluded from that feature's source list).

features.name: Ticket management
features.description: Create, view, update, and track support tickets/conversations through a status lifecycle.

provenance.notes: Four independent implementations, each with its own status enum: chatwoot (open/resolved/pending/snoozed), zammad (new/open/pending reminder/pending close/closed/merged), osTicket (open/resolved/closed/archived/deleted), freescout (active/pending/closed/spam). The domain's canonical state machine synthesizes a common new→open→pending→resolved→closed pattern across all four rather than copying one verbatim.

features.name: Queues / inboxes
features.description: Group tickets into queues, inboxes, or departments so teams see only the tickets relevant to them.

provenance.notes: All four confirmed: chatwoot inbox/team_id, zammad ticket group, osTicket dept, freescout mailbox.

features.name: Ticket assignment
features.description: Assign a ticket to a specific agent, and reassign it as needed.

provenance.notes: All four confirmed: chatwoot conversations.assignee_id, zammad ticket owner, osTicket staff assignment, freescout assignee. Automatic round-robin/load-based routing was NOT independently confirmed in any of the four this pass — scoped to manual assignment only; do not read this as evidence for auto-routing algorithms.

features.name: SLA management
features.description: Define first-response and resolution time targets per priority/queue and track tickets against them.

provenance.notes: Three independent implementations: zammad (explicit Sla model with response_time/update_time), osTicket (SLA model with grace_period), chatwoot (sla_policy_id + AppliedSla, core not enterprise-gated). FreeScout explicitly excluded: no SLA model found in its core AGPL code — confirmed to be one of its paid Modules/ add-ons instead.

features.name: Escalation
features.description: Automatically escalate a ticket (reassign, notify a manager, raise priority) when it breaches its SLA.

provenance.notes: Same three sources as SLA management: zammad's escalation calculation engine, osTicket's FLAG_ESCALATE/FLAG_NOALERTS bitflags, chatwoot's AppliedSla.

features.name: Email channel
features.description: Create and reply to tickets via email, with reply threading matched back to the original ticket.

provenance.notes: Email is the one channel confirmed in all four sources.

features.name: Live chat channel
features.description: A website chat widget that creates and updates tickets in real time.

provenance.notes: Three independent implementations: chatwoot's core widget product, freescout's TYPE_CHAT enum value, zammad's chat channel. osTicket not confirmed for chat this pass.

features.name: Voice / phone channel
features.description: Log a phone call as a ticket, optionally integrated with an IVR or call system.

provenance.notes: Two directly confirmed: freescout's explicit TYPE_PHONE enum value, chatwoot's voice channel. Zammad's phone/CTI support was not independently verified this pass, so it is not counted toward this feature's confidence despite being referenced in general product knowledge.

features.name: Knowledge base
features.description: Public and/or internal help-center articles, organized into categories, with search.

provenance.notes: Three independent implementations: chatwoot (Article + portal/category/folder), zammad (KnowledgeBase model with categories and sorting modes), osTicket (class.knowledgebase.php + class.faq.php).

features.name: Macros / canned responses
features.description: Saved reply templates and/or bulk multi-step actions an agent can apply to a ticket in one click.

provenance.notes: Two independent implementations: chatwoot's Macro model (personal/global visibility, multi-action incl. change_status/assign_team/send_webhook_event), osTicket's class.canned.php. Not found in zammad or freescout core.

features.name: CSAT surveys
features.description: Send a post-resolution customer satisfaction survey and record the rating/feedback.

provenance.notes: Single verified implementation: chatwoot's CsatSurveyResponse model (rating + feedback + review notes). Not verified in zammad or osTicket core this pass; noted in freescout as one of its paid Modules add-ons. Deliberately not claimed at medium/high.

features.name: Customer self-service portal
features.description: A logged-in area where a customer can view, create, and track their own tickets.

provenance.notes: Three independent implementations: osTicket's dedicated client/ directory, chatwoot's widget + portal, zammad's customer-role frontend (belongs_to :customer on Ticket, core_workflow_permission 'ticket.customer').

features.name: Internal notes
features.description: Private, agent-only notes on a ticket that the customer never sees, distinct from customer-visible replies.

provenance.notes: Two independent implementations: chatwoot's Message.private boolean field, osTicket's explicit 'N' (note) thread-entry type plus a FLAG_SYSTEM system-note flag. Not independently confirmed in zammad's article model this pass.

features.name: Tags and categorization
features.description: Apply free-form tags or fixed categories to tickets for filtering and reporting.

provenance.notes: Two independent implementations: chatwoot's Label model, zammad's Tag model.

features.name: Business hours / holiday calendar
features.description: Define operating hours and holidays that SLA countdown timers pause outside of.

provenance.notes: Single verified implementation: zammad's calendar.rb (business hours + holidays feeding SLA/escalation calculations). Not independently confirmed in osTicket or chatwoot this pass despite both having SLA models.

features.name: Automation rules
features.description: Trigger-based automation on ticket events (time-based or field-change), e.g. auto-tag, auto-assign, or notify.

provenance.notes: zammad's Trigger model (condition/perform, fully automatic) is the stronger source; chatwoot's Macro (change_status/assign_team/send_webhook_event actions) is agent-triggered rather than fully automatic, so it is weaker evidence for the same underlying capability. Two sources, one strong one weak.

features.name: Reporting and analytics
features.description: Dashboards on ticket volume, agent performance, and SLA compliance.

provenance.notes: Single verified implementation: chatwoot's core (non-enterprise) api/v2/accounts/reports_controller.rb, live_reports_controller.rb, and summary_reports_controller.rb. Depends on shared.reporting for the underlying aggregation/chart/export engine.

features.name: Unified multichannel inbox
features.description: Present tickets from every channel (email, chat, voice, social) in one inbox per customer, rather than siloed by channel.

provenance.notes: chatwoot's inbox model spans multiple channel types feeding one conversation list; freescout's TYPE_EMAIL/PHONE/CHAT/CUSTOM enum on the same conversation model confirms the same unifying shape.
